input.overview: Cleopatra pairs each colored top rollover with the same-colored center drop target. Collecting a color's lane and target raises that color's bonus contribution; completing either the full rollover set or the full drop bank alternately lights a bull's-eye target for Extra Ball and Special. The two side holes collect doubled bonus when lit, making controlled shots to the top the safest way to build value before a saucer cashout.
input.simpleOverview: Send the ball to the top to collect colored rollovers, then hit the matching center drops to raise bonus. Completing every rollover or every drop alternately lights a bull's-eye for Extra Ball and Special. When a side hole is lit, shoot it to collect double bonus.
input.summary: Favor the top lanes and saucers because straight center-drop hits can rebound dangerously. When forced into the bank, hit colors whose matching top rollovers are already collected; this converts the risk into immediate bonus growth.

quickInfo.name: Build Safely
quickInfo.summary: Favor top-lane and side-hole feeds over square center-bank hits.

steps.text: Shoot to the top and collect as many colored rollovers as possible.
Hit center drops whose matching rollover colors are already lit to raise those bonus values.
Complete all rollovers or all drops to light the bull's-eye targets alternately for Extra Ball and Special.
Shoot a lit side hole to collect double bonus, then rebuild from the top.

alternatives.title: Upper-playfield route
alternatives.when: Use this when center-bank rebounds are especially dangerous.

steps.text: Keep sending the ball through the top lanes.
Nudge bumper exits toward a side hole for a possible repeat feed.
Take only clean edge shots at the center drops needed to complete matched colors.
Complete matching rollover-and-drop color pairs to grow the base bonus.
When either side hole's double-bonus lamp is lit, shoot that hole.
Collect the built doubled bonus before taking more center-bank risk.

machineSetup: Identify Cleopatra EM, Cleopatra solid-state, or the two-player Pyramid edition; test the red, white, blue, yellow, and green lanes and drops, both bull's-eyes, both side holes and ejects, three pop bumpers, and bonus ladder.
Confirm three- or five-ball settings, Extra Ball and Special behavior, last-ball double bonus, and whether the side-hole ejects can be nudged into repeatable upper-playfield action.

cautions.issue: The catalog groups EM, solid-state, and two-player Pyramid editions.
cautions.response: The core color-pair and award rules agree, but player count, score display, and operator awards vary; verify the apron card before competition.
